title: Đề Dự Đoán 17 — Nature club mới

provenance.path: APTIS/Writing/Bộ đề dự đoán/Nature club mới.docx

parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt: What do you like to do when you spend time outdoors ?

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Can you tell me a time when you got lost.
What kind of destination do you like visiting? Why?
Natural places are welcoming more and more tourists on their holiday. I think it is a bad thing. Do you agree? Why?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
You are a member of Nature club and you have just received an email from the club’s manager.
Dear members,
The club received two invitations for local project support and can only choose one. The first option is to create a plan for a park where members can publicly observe animal behaviors. The second option is a tree-planting support project where everyone works together. Which project is more suitable and give your suggestions?
Manager.
Q1: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of the club. Tell your friend how you feel and what suggestions you will make and why. Write about 50 words.
Recommended time: 10 minutes.
Q2: Write an email to the manager. Tell the manager how you feel, what suggestions you will make and why. Write 120-150 words.
Recommended time: 20 minutes

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your friend who is also a member of Nature club mới. Express your thoughts and feelings about the announcement and suggest what you both should do.
Write an email to the president/manager of Nature club mới. Give your detailed feedback, propose constructive solutions for the initiative, and explain why your suggestions would benefit the club.
